camel_example: aliyun ocr RecognizeTable --region cn-hangzhou --HasLine false --SkipDetection false --OutputFormat json --ImageURL 'http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/ocr/RecognizeTable/RecognizeTable4.jpg' --UseFinanceModel true --AssureDirection false
description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of RecognizeTable for table recognition
description_zh: 本文介绍表格识别RecognizeTable的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun ocr recognize-table --image-url http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/ocr/RecognizeTable/RecognizeTable4.jpg --output-format json --use-finance-model true --assure-direction false --has-line false --skip-detection false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeTable

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The output format is `json`. (`html` and `xlsx` are deprecated. If you set this parameter to `html` or `xlsx`, the output is still in JSON format.)
parameters.help_zh: 输出格式为`json`。（`html`、`xlsx`已废弃，当选择`html`、`xlsx`入参，最终输出也为JSON格式。）
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the financial statement model. Valid values:
- true: Use the financial statement model.
- false: Do not use the financial statement model
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用财务报表模型。
- true：财务报表模型

- false：非财务报表模型
parameters.name: use_finance_model

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the image direction is confirmed to be upright. Valid values:
- true: The image is upright.
- false: The image is not upright
parameters.help_zh:
图像方向是否确定为正向。

- true：正向

- false：反向
parameters.name: assure_direction

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the table has no lines. Valid values:
- true: The table has no lines or has only horizontal lines without vertical lines.
- false: The table has lines
parameters.help_zh:
是否无线条。

- true：无线条或者只有横线没有竖线

- false：有线条
parameters.name: has_line

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip detection. Valid values:
- true: Skip detection.
- false: Do not skip detection
parameters.help_zh:
是否跳过检测。
- true：跳过检查

- false：不跳过检查
parameters.name: skip_detection
